title: ENS Enterprises IPO Details
intro:
ENS Enterprises IPO is a book build issue of ₹33.14 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 0.36 crore shares of ₹33.14 crore.

ENS Enterprises IPO opens for subscription on Aug 14, 2026 and closes on Aug 18, 2026. The allotment for the ENS Enterprises IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 19, 2026. ENS Enterprises IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Aug 21, 2026.

ENS Enterprises IPO is set issue price band at ₹87 to ₹92 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,20,800 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,31,200.

Corporate Makers Capital Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Abhipra Capital Limited is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to ENS Enterprises IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in January 2016, ENS Enterprises Limited provides end-to-end digital commerce enablement and software solutions.
The company has established a strong presence in domestic and international markets, supporting clients in 12+ countries with over 140 professionals.
It offers a broad service portfolio, successfully delivering IT projects and establishing itself as a trusted technology partner for corporations, SMEs, and government initiatives.
The majority of the company's revenues are generated from India, but the company has also made its presence internationally, viz. United States, Japan, Singapore, the UK, and Canada.
As of 30 September 2025, the team comprises approximately 148 members, including Directors, KMP, and SMP, but excluding Non-Executive Independent Directors and employees.

faqs.question: How to apply in ENS Enterprises IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in ENS Enterprises IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in ENS Enterprises IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in ENS Enterprises IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' ENS Enterprises IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When ENS Enterprises IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The ENS Enterprises IPO opens on Fri, Aug 14, 2026 and closes on Tue, Aug 18, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of ENS Enterprises IPO?
faqs.answer: ENS Enterprises IPO lot size is 1200 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,20,800 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for ENS Enterprises IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in ENS Enterprises IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is ENS Enterprises IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for ENS Enterprises IPO will be done on Wednesday, August 19, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Aug 20, 2026 . Check the ENS Enterprises IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is ENS Enterprises IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The ENS Enterprises IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Fri, Aug 21, 2026 .
